name: @vikasbaplawat1/pulse-sdk
description: Enterprise-grade observability SDK with error tracking, tracing, metrics, and breadcrumbs

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const root=process.cwd(); const remove=(p)=>fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true}); remove(path.join(root,'dist')); const walk=(dir)=>{ if(!fs.existsSync(dir)) return; for(const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true})){ const full=path.join(dir,entry.name); if(entry.isDirectory()) walk(full); else if(/\.(js|js\.map|d\.ts|d\.ts\.map)$/.test(entry.name)) fs.rmSync(full,{force:true}); } }; walk(path.join(root,'src'));"
